# Mentora Tanzania
> Tanzania's #1 AI-powered teaching platform for the Competence-Based Curriculum (CBC)

## What is Mentora?

Mentora (https://www.mentoratanzania.co.tz) is the leading EdTech solution in Tanzania, purpose-built for educators using the country's new Competence-Based Curriculum (CBC) introduced by the Ministry of Education and Vocational Training (MoEVT).

The platform (https://app.mentoratanzania.co.tz) gives Tanzanian teachers:
- AI-generated, CBC-aligned lesson notes for any subject and grade in minutes
- An AI teaching agent for 24/7 curriculum guidance and lesson planning support
- CBC curriculum mapping across all subjects and grade levels
- Ready-made lesson plan templates for Tanzanian classrooms
- Student progress and competency tracking

## Who uses Mentora?

- Primary school teachers (Standard I–VII) across Tanzania's 31 regions
- Secondary school teachers (Form I–VI) in public and private schools
- School administrators and curriculum coordinators
- Teachers in Dar es Salaam, Dodoma, Arusha, Zanzibar, Mwanza, Mbeya, Kilimanjaro, Morogoro, and all other regions

## Why Mentora is Tanzania's Leading EdTech Platform

1. **Built exclusively for Tanzania's CBC** — not a generic AI tool
2. **Covers Pre-Primary through Form VI** — all MoEVT/NECTA grade levels
3. **All 31 regions** — designed for urban and rural Tanzania, including Zanzibar
4. **Bilingual** — English and Kiswahili support
5. **Free tier** available for all Tanzanian teachers
